entities.summary: Dorette Corbey is a Dutch politician and former Member of the European Parliament (MEP). She is a member of the Partij van de Arbeid, which is part of the Party of European Socialists, and sat on the European Parliament's Committee on the Environment, Public Health and Food Safety.
